note: Drops the hand-maintained topic Literal and types the model's topic field directly as Conversation.Topic.
Moves the HogQL validation-error enrichment into posthog/hogql/metadata.py and removes the schema helpers and route from the API view.
Replaces the loader with a single manual reducer holding all success/failure/reset handlers plus a listener, so the reducer is defined in one place.
Removes the BillingManager private-method call entirely, deriving eligibility from the org's synced plan tier instead of exposing a public method.
Switches the import from the CDP service to a HogTransformer interface in ~/common/hog-transformations.
Renames _wait_for_signal to _wait_for_task_external_event and updates its caller.
Splits blob offload into a sequential extract step and a fan-out/fan-in stage uploading blobs concurrently with a max-concurrency cap.
Updates the reference doc and SKILL.md to extract symbol sets via posthog-cli; the duplicated reference file is kept.
Deletes the propagation function that read sync_type_config directly, replacing it with a precedence flip elsewhere, rather than using schema_metadata.
Deletes ingestion-recordings-server.ts and adds ingestion-session-replay-server.ts plus a separate recording API server.
Keeps the Postgres source-type check and adds a team feature-flag gate to xmin_available.
Renames MarketingAnalyticsMaxToolWrapper to MarketingAnalyticsAIToolWrapper and its usage.
Pure directory rename of the skill; the CLI-based extraction in the script was introduced in an earlier commit, not this one.
Replaces signal_autonomy route with signals/config backed by a SignalTeamConfigViewSet and regroups routes under signals/.
Adds a LimitKey StrEnum and uses its members as registry keys and at call sites.
Removes dedicated /bedrock routes; existing Anthropic endpoints route to Bedrock via a provider field and optional fallback.
Deletes the local ownerName helper and uses fullName from lib/utils with email fallback.
Only strips explanatory comments from the materialized-column tests; no printer routing change.
Moves DashboardsContent and related experiment files into products/dashboards/frontend; the file stays separate.
Removes the section header comments from the validation file but does not split it into two files.
